Since the teammate stated "docstrings are the source of truth," this discrepancy needs to be resolved. Please either:
1. Update the docstring to explicitly document that words after colons are capitalized (similar to first words), or
2. Remove the after-colon logic and implement only what the docstring specifies

This ensures the docstring remains the accurate specification for the function's behavior.
